# InHand Networks 市场素材 / Marketing Assets

> 映翰通公开市场素材：产品图片、宣传册、彩页规格书、视频，以及解决方案和品牌资料，按中文(zh)/英文(en)组织。
> 机器可读的完整清单见 catalog.json；工程版规格书与手册见 https://github.com/inhandnet/documents

## 中文素材 (zh)

### 小星云管家 — 云服务

- [InCloud-Manager_1_ZH.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/zh/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_1_ZH.png) (images, png, 1122×1402): 小星云智能体网络运维宣传图：机器人置于网络监控大屏前，中文文案“少翻页面，直接解决”。
- [InCloud-Manager_2_ZH.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/zh/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_2_ZH.png) (images, png, 1122×1402): 网络运维痛点宣传图：运维人员面对多块监控屏，展示站点多、信息散、操作杂三项问题。
- [InCloud-Manager_3_ZH.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/zh/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_3_ZH.png) (images, png, 1122×1402): 小星云管家智能体使用方式对比图：展示设备上云、企业自有 Agent 和设备直连三类场景。
- [InCloud-Manager_4_ZH.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/zh/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_4_ZH.png) (images, png, 1122×1402): 小星云智能体任务流程图：依次展示提出任务、获取信息、确认执行和检查结果。

### ODU12 — 5G & 4G 路由器 / 室外路由器

- [ODU12_Flyer_ZH.pdf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/zh/products/ODU12/brochures/ODU12_Flyer_ZH.pdf) (brochures, pdf): ODU12 中文产品宣传册，介绍 5G 户外 AI 原生路由器的产品特点、应用场景、规格参数及订购信息。

## English assets (en)

### InCloud Manager — Cloud Service

- [InCloud-Manager_1_EN.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_1_EN.png) (images, png, 1344×1680): InCloud Agent network operations graphic with a robot before monitoring dashboards and the message “Less searching. More solving.”
- [InCloud-Manager_2_EN.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_2_EN.png) (images, png, 1344×1680): Network operations pain-point graphic showing an operator facing multiple dashboards, highlighting more sites, scattered data, and too many steps.
- [InCloud-Manager_3_EN.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_3_EN.png) (images, png, 1344×1680): InCloud Manager comparison chart showing cloud-managed devices, an existing AI agent, and off-cloud or private-network devices.
- [InCloud-Manager_4_EN.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/InCloud-Manager/images/InCloud-Manager_4_EN.png) (images, png, 1344×1680): InCloud Agent workflow graphic showing task description, information gathering, confirmation and execution, and result verification.

### ODU12 — 5G & 4G Routers / Outdoor Routers

- [ODU12_Rural_Outdoor_5G_Coming_Soon_EN.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/ODU12/images/ODU12_Rural_Outdoor_5G_Coming_Soon_EN.png) (images, png, 3840×4800): English ODU12 Coming Soon poster showing the outdoor 5G router mounted on a rural utility pole, with farmland and hills in the background.
- [ODU12_Urban_Outdoor_5G_Coming_Soon_EN.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/ODU12/images/ODU12_Urban_Outdoor_5G_Coming_Soon_EN.png) (images, png, 3840×4800): English ODU12 Coming Soon poster showing the outdoor 5G router mounted at a rooftop restaurant overlooking a city skyline at sunset.
- [ODU12_Verizon_Certified_EN.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/ODU12/images/ODU12_Verizon_Certified_EN.png) (images, png, 1122×1402): English ODU12 Verizon Certified promotional poster showing the outdoor 5G router installed on an exterior wall beside a waterfront café.
- [ODU12_Verizon_Certified_V2_EN.jpg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/ODU12/images/ODU12_Verizon_Certified_V2_EN.jpg) (images, jpg, 1122×1402): Alternate English ODU12 Verizon Certified promotional poster featuring the outdoor 5G router against residential, snowy, and commercial building scenes.
- [ODU12_Creative_Video_EN](https://github.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/releases/download/ODU12-en/ODU12_Creative_Video_EN.mp4) (videos, video): English ODU12 creative video using a balance-scale concept to present the product’s outdoor 5G value.

### ODU302 — 5G & 4G Routers / Outdoor Routers

- [ODU302_Flyer_EN.pdf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inhandnet/marketing-assets/main/en/products/ODU302/brochures/ODU302_Flyer_EN.pdf) (brochures, pdf): English ODU302 4G outdoor router flyer covering product overview, application scenarios, key features, specifications, and ordering information.
